published_figures.label: Published figures
published_figures.definition: Rows of potholes_long.csv, one per place, period and measure.

long_csv_mb.label: Size of potholes_long.csv
long_csv_mb.definition: Its size in bytes divided by 1,000,000.

community_areas.label: Community areas
community_areas.definition: community_area rows of geo_denominators.csv, the UNASSIGNED bucket excluded.

wards.label: Wards
wards.definition: ward2023 rows of geo_denominators.csv, the UNASSIGNED bucket excluded.

winters_charted.label: Winters on the chart
winters_charted.definition: Rows of winter_harshness.csv from W2020 on; W2019 is published but not charted, under the 2019 policy.

reference_winters.label: Reference winters
reference_winters.definition: The winters 1991–92 to 2020–21 each z-score is measured against (winter_reference_stats.json n).

reference_winters_with_snow_gaps.label: Reference winters with missing snow readings
reference_winters_with_snow_gaps.definition: Entries in reference_data_gaps: reference winters in which O'Hare's snow readings have gaps, counted as zero.

rpt_n_cy2025.label: Pothole reports, 2025
rpt_n_cy2025.definition: Distinct reported pothole problems citywide in calendar 2025 (rpt_n, CY2025).

rpt_n_cy2025_approx.label: Pothole reports, 2025, rounded
rpt_n_cy2025_approx.definition: The same figure to the nearest 1,000.

close_p50_d_cy2025.label: Median days to close, 2025
close_p50_d_cy2025.definition: Survival-curve median days until 311 closed a 2025 report (close_p50_d, CY2025).

rpt_patched_share_cy2025.label: Reports with a recorded patch, 2025
rpt_patched_share_cy2025.definition: Share of completed 2025 reports with a linked Potholes Patched record (rpt_patched_share 0.7121).

rpt_patched_share_cy2024.label: Reports with a recorded patch, 2024
rpt_patched_share_cy2024.definition: Share of completed 2024 reports with a linked Potholes Patched record (rpt_patched_share 0.7668).

rpt_patched_share_cy2025_approx.label: Reports with a recorded patch, 2025, rounded
rpt_patched_share_cy2025_approx.definition: The same share to the nearest percent.

fill_n_cy2025.label: Potholes filled, 2025
fill_n_cy2025.definition: Per-block pothole counts crews entered on 2025 work orders, summed (fill_n, CY2025).

fill_n_cy2025_approx.label: Potholes filled, 2025, rounded
fill_n_cy2025_approx.definition: The same figure to the nearest 1,000.

rpt_dup_share_cy2019.label: Reports flagged as duplicates, 2019
rpt_dup_share_cy2019.definition: Share of in-demand 2019 street requests that were effective duplicates (rpt_dup_share 0.4677).

rpt_n_cy2019.label: Pothole reports, 2019
rpt_n_cy2019.definition: Distinct reported pothole problems citywide in calendar 2019 (rpt_n, CY2019).

unplaced_2019_pct.label: 2019 reports not placed in a community area
unplaced_2019_pct.definition: 891 of 42,535 2019 reports fell outside every community-area polygon (qa_report.json join_loss, rpt_n, community_area).

unplaced_2019_n.label: 2019 reports not placed
unplaced_2019_n.definition: The unassigned count behind the share above.

unplaced_later_min_pct.label: Lowest share unplaced, 2020 to 2025
unplaced_later_min_pct.definition: The smallest community-area join loss for rpt_n over CY2020–CY2025 (CY2023).

unplaced_later_max_pct.label: Highest share unplaced, 2020 to 2025
unplaced_later_max_pct.definition: The largest over the same years (CY2024).

patch_within_minute_pct.label: Linked patch records logged within a minute of closure
patch_within_minute_pct.definition: Diagnostic D4: share of linked pairs whose patch completion is within 60 seconds of the 311 close.

patch_linked_pairs.label: Linked patch–report pairs
patch_linked_pairs.definition: D4's n: the linked pairs tested.

alley_close_withheld_cy2024.label: Community areas with alley closing time withheld, 2024
alley_close_withheld_cy2024.definition: alley_close_p50_d rows for CY2024 that are blank under the minimum-n rule, of 77 community areas with a row.

alley_close_withheld_cy2025.label: Community areas with alley closing time withheld, 2025
alley_close_withheld_cy2025.definition: alley_close_p50_d rows for CY2025 that are blank under the minimum-n rule, of 76 community areas with a row.

alley_close_withheld_ytd2025_08.label: Community areas with alley closing time withheld, Jan–Aug 2025
alley_close_withheld_ytd2025_08.definition: alley_close_p50_d rows for YTD2025-08 that are blank under the minimum-n rule, of 76 community areas with a row.

alley_close_withheld_ytd2026_08.label: Community areas with alley closing time withheld, Jan–Aug 2026
alley_close_withheld_ytd2026_08.definition: alley_close_p50_d rows for YTD2026-08 that are blank under the minimum-n rule, of 76 community areas with a row.

suppression_min_n.label: Minimum records for a published figure
suppression_min_n.definition: The §7.1 minimum expected count below which a figure is withheld.

suppression_min_p90_n.label: Minimum records for a 90th percentile
suppression_min_p90_n.definition: The §7.1 minimum n for a 90th percentile.

extreme_fill_threshold.label: Extreme fill entry
extreme_fill_threshold.definition: Potholes on one block at or above which a crew entry is extreme.

extreme_fill_flag_pct.label: Extreme share that flags an area-year
extreme_fill_flag_pct.definition: Share of an area-year's fills from extreme entries at which EXTREME_FILL is set.

geography_loss_cap_pct.label: Geography loss cap (V3)
geography_loss_cap_pct.definition: Check V3's cap on the share of each count, in each year, that could not be placed in a geography.

km_tolerance_days.label: Survival-median tolerance (V7b)
km_tolerance_days.definition: Check V7b's tolerance, in days, between the survival-curve median and the median of closed reports alone.

snap_target_pct.label: Centerline snap target (D6)
snap_target_pct.definition: Diagnostic D6's target share of reports within the snap distance of a street centerline.

ward_field_trigger_pct.label: Ward-field disagreement trigger (D9)
ward_field_trigger_pct.definition: Diagnostic D9's trigger: the share of pre-remap reports whose 311 ward field disagrees with their coordinates.

road_snap_ft.label: Centerline snap distance
road_snap_ft.definition: The distance within which a report is snapped to a street centerline for its road class, in feet.
